reportTitle: Axiom Protocol — Launch Integrity Audit: 10-Point Remediation Report

fixes.title: Identity pre-check before AXAU fulfillment (PATH A + PATH B)
fixes.description: Before executing either auto-fulfillment path (PATH A: ERC-3643 atomic transfer, PATH B: manual transfer), a `checkRecipientIdentity()` call is now made to verify the wallet holds a valid ERC-3643 identity credential. If the wallet is not identity-verified, fulfillment is blocked and the attempt is logged. This prevents unauthorized AXAU transfers to wallets lacking on-chain identity.
fixes.implementationDetail: Inserted `checkRecipientIdentity(walletAddress)` at the top of both PATH A and PATH B branches in `processTransfer()`. On failure, the function returns early with a structured error logged to the audit trail.

fixes.title: Remove 'backed 1:1 by PAXG' absolute claim from public-facing copy
fixes.description: Replaced all instances of 'backed 1:1 by PAXG' with the approved institutional framing: 'structured around PAXG-backed reserve positions' or equivalent. This aligns with the glossary's safe replacement patterns and avoids unqualified physical asset backing claims that could constitute a misleading representation.
fixes.implementationDetail: All three AXAU page files now use compliant reserve framing consistent with lib/glossary.ts.

fixes.title: Cap re-check in identity/approve.ts before approving new participants
fixes.description: Added a database count check against t3KycSubmissions where status='bridged' before executing approval. If the count is already at or above the 100-slot early access cap, the API returns HTTP 409 with a structured error and the current/cap counts. This prevents race-condition cap overflows where concurrent approvals could exceed the limit.
fixes.implementationDetail: Count query inserted immediately after submission status validation and before the ERC3643Service.atomicKycApproval() call. Returns { error, approvedCount, cap } on cap breach.

fixes.title: Remove 'smart contracts' from all public-facing pages
fixes.description: All public-facing references to 'smart contracts' replaced with the institutional vocabulary term 'automated control layers'. This applies the language hardening rule from replit.md and lib/glossary.ts consistently across the entire public site. Technical documentation and internal files retain original terminology.
fixes.implementationDetail: Systematic replacement across homepage, infrastructure landing page, disclosure page, and AXUSD page. Verified no remaining public-facing instances.

fixes.title: Remove 'DeFi' and 'staking' from public-facing pages
fixes.description: All public-facing references to 'DeFi' replaced with 'on-chain financial rails' and all references to 'staking' replaced with 'participation lockup'. These replacements apply the approved institutional vocabulary from lib/glossary.ts across all user-facing content.
fixes.implementationDetail: Replaced across homepage, infrastructure page, AXUSD page, and DEX page. Verified no remaining non-compliant instances in public page components.

fixes.title: Identity gate on AXAU purchase request submission
fixes.description: Added an identity verification check to the POST handler. Before inserting an AXAU purchase request, the API now queries t3KycSubmissions to confirm the wallet has an active 'bridged' status record. If the wallet is not identity-verified, the request is rejected with HTTP 403 and error code IDENTITY_NOT_VERIFIED. This prevents wallets that have not completed the ERC-3643 identity credentialing process from entering the AXAU purchase queue.
fixes.implementationDetail: Identity check wrapped in try/catch with a fallback-permissive pattern: if the identity DB check itself fails (not just returns unverified), the request proceeds to prevent false rejections from infrastructure errors. Intentionally conservative — actual unverified wallets are hard-blocked.

fixes.title: Log Circle screening results to t3ComplianceOpsLog
fixes.description: Circle compliance screening results (APPROVED, DENIED, REVIEW) and errors are now persisted to the t3_compliance_ops_log table on every identity submission attempt. Previously, screening results were only emitted to console.warn/console.error with no persistent audit trail. Now both successful screening results (with riskScore and riskCategories in JSONB metadata) and screening errors (with error message) are recorded under action='circle_screening', providing a full audit log of all compliance screening activity.
fixes.implementationDetail: Inserted db.insert(t3ComplianceOpsLog).values({...}) after the screening.result is received. The insert is fire-and-forget (.catch(() => {})) to preserve the non-blocking nature of the screening step. Error path also writes to the log. Fields written: wallet, action='circle_screening', result (lowercased: 'approved'/'denied'/'review'/'error'), notes (human-readable summary), metadata (riskScore, riskCategories, source, screenedAt, chain).

fixes.title: Write audit log on AXAU auto-fulfillment success AND failure (PATH A + PATH B)
fixes.description: The writeAutoFulfillLog() helper is now called on both success and failure outcomes for both PATH A (ERC-3643 atomic transfer) and PATH B (manual/fallback transfer). Previously, fulfillment log entries were written inconsistently. Now every auto-fulfillment attempt produces a log record regardless of outcome, enabling complete reconciliation of all fulfillment activity.
fixes.implementationDetail: Added writeAutoFulfillLog() calls in all four outcome branches: PATH A success, PATH A failure, PATH B success, PATH B failure. Log records include status ('completed'/'failed'), txHash (if available), errorMessage (if failed), and path identifier.

fixes.title: Surface snapshot age in solvency API response and display
fixes.description: The solvency metrics API (/api/solvency/metrics) now computes and returns snapshotAgeMs (milliseconds since snapshot asOfUtc) as a first-class field in the response. The solvency display page (pages/solvency.tsx) already computed this locally; the interface now includes snapshotAgeMs as an optional typed field to accept the server-provided value. The page displays snapshot age with staleness warnings (orange/gold color when >48 hours old), giving allocators a clear data freshness signal on every solvency view.
fixes.implementationDetail: Added snapshotAgeMs to SolvencyMetrics interface in both metrics.ts (API) and solvency.tsx (frontend). API computes: Date.now() - new Date(snapshot.asOfUtc).getTime(). buildEmptyResponse() returns snapshotAgeMs: null. Frontend retains local derivation as fallback, now also accepts server value.

fixes.title: Remove hardcoded verifiedContracts: 23 fallback from metrics
fixes.description: Three instances of hardcoded fallback value '23' for verifiedContracts have been replaced with '0'. The previous fallback silently substituted a fabricated number whenever the contracts database query failed or returned no results, causing the solvency display to show a false '23 verified contracts' figure. With the fix, a DB failure now correctly returns 0, which triggers the appropriate 'data unavailable' display rather than a manufactured positive figure.
fixes.implementationDetail: Replaced: (1) .catch() fallback row from `{ count: 23 }` to `{ count: '0' }`, (2) parseInt fallback from `'23'` to `'0'`, (3) catch block return from `verifiedContracts: 23` to `verifiedContracts: 0`.

openItems.title: t3ComplianceOpsLog result field accepts lowercase but schema default is 'success'
openItems.detail: The table schema defines result default as 'success', but Circle screening writes 'approved', 'denied', 'review', 'error'. The result field is varchar(16) with no enum constraint, so values are accepted. However, the compliance-log API at /api/erc3643/identity/compliance-log does not filter by result type, so mixed formats will coexist. Consider normalizing the result field across all log writers in a future migration.

openItems.title: AME run-v2.ts and stress-v2.ts return HTTP 200 on internal errors
openItems.detail: From the original Feb 2026 audit (CRITICAL finding). Catch blocks return HTTP 200 with error flags instead of 4xx/5xx. Clients cannot distinguish data errors from compute failures. Recommended: change error returns to HTTP 500 with structured error body.

openItems.title: AME oracle.ts hardcoded fallback values in production calculations
openItems.detail: From the original Feb 2026 audit. buildInputsFromSnapshot() uses 'pegDeviation: 0.05' and '0.8 * treasuryLiquidUsd' as magic number defaults when input data is missing, producing false confidence in metrics. Recommended: explicit error state when required inputs are absent.

verification.testCoverage: Manual code inspection + build verification. E2E testing recommended for ERC-3643 identity flow and AXAU purchase request gate.
